messages:
Maria (Sales): Customer legal sent a SIG-lite + custom questionnaire asking for evidence around SSO, MFA enforcement, RBAC and provisioning for the POC. They want artifacts by EOD tomorrow. Can infra/security help gather a minimal bundle we can hand them?
Beth SE: Yep. We should include: SAML metadata XML, IdP config screenshot, MFA policy screenshot showing 'enforce on all users', RBAC matrix for the POC org, and a sample audit log for a user change. Also mention SCIM support status.
Alex B: Quick heads up: hosted API supports SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated) and JIT account creation. We do NOT expose SCIM write APIs on hosted right now. Dedicated customers can get SCIM via the provisioning connector.
Tim Infra: I can grab the SAML metadata + example assertion. Where should I drop them? internal share or put on the secure drive?
Sam (Security): Secure drive link is fine but we need to ensure links are timebound and logged. Also include an exported snippet of an auth audit (anonymized). They often ask for proof of MFA enforcement — send screenshots of the policy page and a syslog entry showing an MFA challenge success.
Maria (Sales): Customer also asked whether RBAC supports least-privilege roles (service-only tokens, route-scoped roles). Need a short explanation and an RBAC CSV. Can we produce that?
Beth SE: I have an RBAC CSV template. I'll fill with POC roles: admin, deployer, viewer, model-infer, billing-reader. I'll mark which APIs/scopes each role can access.
Alex B: For the MFA evidence: hosted supports MFA via the IdP (we honor authn context). For customers who want provider-enforced MFA, include a note: "MFA enforced at identity provider; Redwood honors authn context and requires reauth for console actions." Add the policy screenshot and a SAML assertion example with acr claim.
Tim Infra: Dropping artifacts to secure drive now: https://secure.redwood.internal/drive/poc-17999/sso-evidence (expires in 7d). Included files: saml-metadata.xml, idp-config.png, mfa-policy.png, rbac-poc.csv, auth-audit-2026-03.csv, saml-assertion-example.txt
Sam (Security): I'll redact usernames and add a brief cover note describing controls: session timeout, failed-login thresholds, MFA coverage, privileged role review cadence. Also add a statement for SIG question controls 2.1/2.2 about authentication and MFA.
Maria (Sales): Perfect. Can someone draft a 1-page cover note I can attach to SIG/CAIQ that states where each supporting artifact lives and how it maps to the questionnaire rows? Customer wants mapping to row IDs.
Beth SE: I'll draft the mapping. Example line: CAIQ-Auth-1 -> saml-metadata.xml + idp-config.png. CAIQ-Auth-3 -> mfa-policy.png + auth-audit-2026-03.csv.
Alex B: Note on provisioning: for hosted POC we recommend IdP JIT provisioning. For customers requiring SCIM for the POC, we can spin up a Dedicated eval (timeline ~2 weeks) or provide scripted sync as a short-term workaround. I'll put that in the cover note.
POC Bot: POC-17999 created for acme-prospect, owner: Maria (Sales), deadline: 2026-03-28.
Maria (Sales): Thanks all — I'll send the bundle and mapping to the customer's security contact after Beth's draft. If they push for SCIM we can escalate for a Dedicated eval. :thumbsup:
Sam (Security): FYI I've added the artifact set to ticket ENG-POC-987; Audit logs attached. Leaving note to rotate evidence link after 7d.
Beth SE: Draft done, uploading final zip to the secure link. Will ping when live.
Maria (Sales): Great — closing this thread once I confirm delivery.
